notes.title: Mostroscopy Patch 2.9
notes.notes:
Good afternoon everyone!

Mostroscopy Patch 2.9 is now live, also known as the Post Xbox Patch, and well, what can we say, if you have an XBOX you can now enjoy Mostroscopy there too!!

[previewyoutube=Cp9lfywNc0Y;full][/previewyoutube]

We are very happy with this, as it is our second game coming to console, after Combate Monero which is also available on Playstation in addition to Steam!

We were very busy these months making the console port, and we had to optimize many resources and elements of the game, and that was reflected in the quality of some filters in the steam version.

We have already created a new variation of a quality script that adjusts it to the console and steam versions, so if you check the game now it should look better, as it again has ambient occlusion shadows in the game. :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/072ba8d247f041bdbb18c4e3ed3b4401f6a82ef1.png[/img]

In addition to that we altered a Luzbelle challenge, the no. 2, since it was very strange and did not work well, since it was made some time ago before the update and rebalancing patches.

And we also changed the little mistake wich made Japanese the default language in the Main menu. sorry, it should be in english now.

Also, there's a little preview in the jukebox section for the next character... hang on a little longer and new characters, balance and hopefully more stuff will start arriving, also the number 2 of the comic will be available soon as a new DLC :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/ef02ffc60e862d6463f89b45088caef323a0f453.png[/img]

notes.title: Mostroscopy update 2.8!
notes.notes:
Good evening! Today we bring you Mostroscopy update 2.8.

This update includes fixes to some unblockable combos, fixes to fonts and Japanese language handling, changes to the training mode GUI, and also an adjustment to the characters' basic movements that I hope will make the game more dynamic:

By connecting a normal movement and canceling it into a special one, the animation is faster, and that opens up possibilities for new combos :)

Any comments can be written here or on our Discord!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/ab801127d0f6e743fe7de49dd131a86a476a9350.png[/img]

notes.title: A New Mostroscopy Version Arrives!!
notes.notes:
Good afternoon everyone, we are working on adding more features to Mostroscopy and fixing bugs, balance, online play... ugh, but we are a small team and that takes us a lot of time.

Tomorrow, December 2nd, the comic Mostroscopy #1 goes on sale. This comic expands the lore of the game's universe a bit (at least you'll know a bit more about Vampire Woman, Yotecatl, Dr. Tengu Piscuario, Luzbelle and Faust 4) wich we published physically in a very short print about 9 months ago.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/5853f957c1f2a3a3d17bc3a7c3baedac4699199d.jpg[/img]

Well, we're finally releasing it in digital format through Steam, we hope you like it!

In addition to the comic release we've been working on other versions of the game... Wink, Wink. We'll have more information next year (as soon as possible I hope!) and of course the new content of the game that will arrive next year, which as you know is season 2 of characters, and we're already working on the stages and models, as well as fighting styles and stories... the roster is already decided, and there will be content for the WHOLE year :)

you know what? here's a little peek of one of the characters:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/3ea5c41908ecdaf331c140decddbe4a794a41491.jpg[/img]

hehe, not much of a spoiler i guess.

We are also working on comic #2 and another book related to the topic.

I hope you like it and continue supporting Mostroscopy next year!

notes.title: UPDATE 2.4
notes.notes:
Good evening everyone!

Mostroscopy patch 2.4 is now ready!!

This Patch includes several important changes:
[list]
[*] There are a lot of bugs and rebalancing in many many moves, you can see a more detailed list on our Discord.
[*] Evangeline, Eda and Yolanda are now selectable through the game! Finish the game with Faust, Vampire Woman, Yotecatl, Piscuario, Kitty and Drakkenhaussen to unlock Evangeline
[*] Finish the game with Luzbelle, Penumbra, La Llorona and Charro Negro to unlock Eda and Yolanda.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/b547d39a771b9ef2ab359c30c72e2dcd70813509.jpg[/img]

[*] All characters now have their own Story Mode, so you can find out more details about each character's Lore!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/e21ffa4d32bc250580a1991c912cef26cf88f11a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/faeb3fb93e18794f2c61de4e44c582a95f89bbf6.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/7ea29468d71fee81c204d8390330474885ff68dd.jpg[/img]

[*] There are many characters appearing in this mode... will any of them make it to the roster?
[*] Online Mode has some changes, we fixed some issues with the back and rematch buttons, and we added back the server selection option.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/a2b1a64861ed9b890fc77a86ccd6f34650749a26.jpg[/img]

[*] Faust V's stage has some minor visual changes, as the visual effects were a bit heavy and didn't work very well on all hardware. For the time being, it's now simpler.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/f5b4f24080f1cbee02cbccefe996a6a58e2a2439.jpg[/img]

[*] A slight gameplay change, the Guard Cancel that was performed by pressing attack or special while guarding can now only be done with the special button.
[*] We have added the Jukebox option, where you can listen to the songs in the game and see their titles and authors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/2ac5b5136a348a6cc0dec354e19fb4a7a7fdfc85.jpg[/img]
[*] There are a couple of new trophies, "Link to the past" and "Children of the night", hopefully you can unlock them!
[/list]

I think that's all that matters for now, we will continue adding new options, but in the meantime we hope you enjoy this update!!

notes.title: Patch 2.1.3
notes.notes:
Ufff... this update has a lot of little fixes!!
all the next things are fixed:
[list]
[*] There was an error when selecting graveyard TC and BW, the same as Finca Sa. Isabel
[*] The region conection option is now always "best" and automatic
[*] Fixed some screens for online play that wouldn't let players return or cancel when searching matches or joining roooms
[*] Faust V throw can't be spammed no more
[*] Some characters had unblockable moves when executing auto combos.
[*] La llorona intro camera angle has been changed in the meanwhile of us finding a way to make oponents invicible during intros 
[*] Some characters used the wrong voices when using the Guard Counter move
[*] Some crouching moves that looked more like mids have been set as mids 
[*] Faust V's standing autocombo's third attack wouldn't not always hit the opponent, leading to some infinites.
[*] Luzbelle's Back special attack has more frame advantage and hits more consistently
[*] La Mujer Vampiro hitbox for her throw was inconsistent between right and left side.
[*] Kukamon's forward EX special move wouldn't hit all the way into the end and the oponent would recover first
[*] Kukamon's down special move would have the oponent recover faster, now it's fixed
[*] Toshiros neutral special attack proyectile doesn't pull the opponent near him anymore.
[*] El Charro negros Neutral special wouldn't hit really close opponents
[/list]

there are more things to fix, but for a first batch i think this is ok
